assessment: The submitted two-times conversion is not supported after the source's point-spread-function correction: the source reports 72.3 pc and 143.7 pc, whereas doubling 72.3 gives 144.6 pc. The uncertainty interval of the fitted width is also not a controlled input domain for this conversion.

issues.detail: The reported corrected widths are w_pm_1sigma = 72.3 pc and w_pm_2sigma = 143.7 pc, not an exact factor of two. The source states that physical widths are corrected by quadrature subtraction of the PSF.
The range 63.4–81.2 pc is derived from the uncertainty on one fitted stream width; the source does not declare it as a control domain for an exact width conversion.

controls.definition: Total Gaussian-profile stream width measured from the mean minus one standard deviation to the mean plus one standard deviation.
controls.name: width_pm_1sigma

applicability.statement: Applies to the Gaussian fit used to characterize the Oyashio stream candidate's perpendicular brightness profile.
The reported physical width is corrected for the instrumental point-spread function by quadrature subtraction.

readouts.definition: Total Gaussian-profile stream width extending two standard deviations from the mean and enclosing about 95 percent of the Gaussian area.
readouts.name: width_pm_2sigma
